description: This file defines the SubjectNotAccessibleException class, a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a subject was either missing or inaccessible due to insufficient permissions, and it includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON representations. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, and contains a nested Builder class for creating instances with custom parameters.
